2609.26487.title: When Recursive Models Finish Computing
2609.26487.paper_summary: Recursive models can continue updating their latent states beyond their nominal inference budget, so an incorrect output at that budget does not show whether computation is unfinished or has entered a persistently unsuccessful regime. We study the dynamics of completion in attention- and MLP-based Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs) on 1,000 hard Sudoku puzzles. Extending recurrence from the nominal 16 steps to 512 steps increases cumulative exact-solve accuracy from 59.2% to 87.5% for the attention model and from 74.4% to 91.9% for the MLP model, solving more than two-thirds of the puzzles unsolved in the nominal budget. Across both architectures, latent-state motion drops sharply after the first exact solution. Completed states are typically locally contractive along the trajectory direction, even though the same local Jacobian retains strongly expanding directions. We characterize this phenomenon as trajectory-conditioned anisotropic stability. Perturbation experiments confirm this directional stability across both models. The multi-step fate of the maximally expanding direction differs: it is absorbed within 16 steps in the attention model but persists longer in the MLP model. The anisotropic-stability pattern also holds for a second attention checkpoint. Together, these results distinguish nominal-budget failure from completed computation and identify a common dynamical signature of completion across two recurrent architectures.
2609.26487.paper_summary_zh: 遞歸模型可以在其名義推斷預算之外持續更新其潛在狀態，因此在該預算下的錯誤輸出並不能顯示計算是否未完成或已進入持續失敗的狀態。<lb/>我們研究了基於注意力和多層感知器（MLP）的微型遞歸模型（TRMs）在1,000個困難數獨謎題上的完成動態。<lb/>將遞歸從名義的16步延伸到512步，將注意力模型的累積精確解決率從59.2%提高到87.5%，而MLP模型則從74.4%提高到91.9%，解決了名義預算下未解決的超過三分之二的謎題。<lb/>在這兩種架構中，潛在狀態的運動在第一次精確解決後急劇下降。<lb/>完成的狀態通常在軌跡方向上是局部收縮的，即使同一局部雅可比矩陣保持強烈擴張的方向。<lb/>我們將這一現象描述為軌跡條件的各向異性穩定性。<lb/>擾動實驗確認了這種方向穩定性在兩種模型中的存在。<lb/>最大擴張方向的多步命運有所不同：在注意力模型中，它在16步內被吸收，但在MLP模型中持續時間更長。<lb/>這種各向異性穩定模式在第二個注意力檢查點上也成立。<lb/>綜合這些結果，區分了名義預算失敗與完成計算，並確定了兩種遞歸架構之間的共同動態特徵。
